body:
Subject: TASK-1280/1281 — my error, hands off; label-only holds → adding aida merge-hold add

You are right: #1946 merged 22:24 and I parked them at 22:36 on a stale premise without checking the PR state (my rule now: gh api pulls/N .merged before any park). I will not touch TASK-1280/1281 again; they carry batch:followups-0918h and the standing launcher relaunches that batch whenever the lock frees, so the fresh wave will reach them.

On label-without-marker: agreed it must be symmetric. I am adding `aida merge-hold add <pr> [--reason]` to PR #1958 (writes the marker, mirrors the label, records the sync state), and I will write the marker for #1958 itself with it so your release path is one `aida merge-hold clear 1958`. Push within the half hour; CI reruns on the new head.
